services.title: Custom Celebration Cakes
services.description: Tell us your vision for birthdays, weddings, or anniversaries. We create one-of-a-kind cakes with flavors and designs you choose, from classic vanilla to our signature North West honeycomb.

services.title: Cupcakes & Treats by the Dozen
services.description: Perfect for office parties, school events, or just because. Choose from our daily menu or order a custom batch with your favorite frosting and toppings.

services.title: Event Catering
services.description: We provide dessert tables and pastry platters for events across North West. We handle the setup so you can enjoy your party.

testimonials.text: Lety made our wedding cake exactly how we dreamed. The lemon zest flavor was incredible, and she even delivered it to the venue in Potchefstroom herself.
testimonials.name: Sarah & James

testimonials.text: I order cupcakes for my shop's monthly customer appreciation day. They're always fresh, and my clients in Klerksdorp love them.
testimonials.name: Thabo M.

testimonials.text: The best carrot cake in the North West. I drive from Rustenburg just for it.
testimonials.name: Annette P.

faq.question: How far in advance should I order a custom cake?
faq.answer: For custom cakes, we recommend at least 2 weeks' notice. For cupcakes or standard orders, 3-5 days is usually fine.

faq.question: Do you deliver?
faq.answer: Yes, we deliver across the North West region. Delivery fees depend on the distance from our bakery.

faq.question: Can you accommodate dietary restrictions?
faq.answer: We offer gluten-free and vegan options for most of our cupcakes and cakes. Please specify your needs when ordering.

faq.question: Where are you located?
faq.answer: Our bakery is in North West. We provide the exact address upon order confirmation for pickup.

motto: Real recipes. Real ingredients. Real good cake.
history: Founded in 2012 by Lety Gibbon in her North West home kitchen, inspired by her Italian grandmother's baking. The business grew through word-of-mouth and now serves customers across the region.
